Application Materials.content:
Your application will only be processed when we have received all the documents and payment. All candidates must submit a statement of purpose, two references, and will be invited for an admissions interview as part of the selection process.
- An updated Resume
- Official academic transcripts of all educational institutions attended.
- 2 Personal Statements:
1. Explain in 500-600 words your career and personal aspirations, and your motivation for pursuing the MSc in Business AI (MBAI) Programme.
2. Discuss in 500-600 words **one** of the following topics: (i) describe your greatest weakness and how you have tried to overcome it (ii) describe your outstanding talents, skills and inherent abilities that are not reflected in your academic qualifications and records (iii) describe the situation with the greatest ethical complexity that you have faced in your professional or academic life, and how your input helped resolved it.
- 2 Referee Reports
- Submit 2 complete sets of referee details during the online process of applying for the MBAI. The application portal will automatically send an email to your referees for them to complete an online recommendation form once you have submitted the application.
- Copy of NRIC/FIN/Passport (in PDF or JPEG format).
- Any other supporting documents
FAQ: Applicants must submit the following documents: a completed online application form, a copy of their NRIC/passport, a bachelor's degree certificate and transcript, a competitive GMAT/GRE/AIQ score report, proof of English proficiency (if applicable), a comprehensive resume/CV, a statement of purpose (essay), and two letters of recommendation.

Interview Requirements.content:
All candidates must submit a statement of purpose, two references, and will be invited for an admissions interview as part of the selection process. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an **online interview within two weeks of the application**.
FAQ: “Is an interview required? Yes. Shortlisted applicants will be invited for an admissions interview.”

Academic Requirements.content:
- The Master of Science in Business AI programme is open to applicants from **all academic backgrounds** who aspire to lead in an AI-enabled business environment.
- Candidates must hold a **recognised bachelor’s degree with a strong academic record**.
- Prior technical or quantitative experience is **beneficial, but not required**; the programme is designed for those seeking to apply AI strategically rather than develop technical AI systems.
- **1 to 5 years of work experience** is preferred; candidates with **no experience** can apply if they possess strong motivation and demonstrate a keen interest in business AI in their application and interview.
- Quantitative or technical experience is preferred.
- No business or technical background is required: the programme accepts applicants from **any discipline** and does not require prior technical training, though quantitative awareness is helpful.
- Coding or programming skills are **not required**.
- SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of **3.0/4.0 or better**, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with cumulative GPAs of **3.5/5.0 or better**, will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for **5 years after graduation**. Meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
Applicants must meet the programme’s AIQ requirement, which can be fulfilled through **GMAT (≥600), GMAT Focus (≥595), GRE (≥312), or the SMU Admissions Test (≥55)**.
- A good GMAT ([try a GMAT mini quiz](https://www.mba.com/gmat-mini-quiz?utm_campaign=Global_All_Mini-Quiz_11Apr2016&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=smu)) / GRE ([try a GRE mini quiz](https://www.ets.org/gre/gre-mini-quiz.html)) / *SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT) score (click [here](https://postgraduate.smu.edu.sg/acton/attachment/11522/f-4aba8d35-81c0-41d8-860f-8aa1c29d5d03/1/-/-/-/-/SMU%20Admissions%20Test%20Fact%20Sheet.pdf) to view the SMUAT Factsheet).
- SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of **3.0/4.0 or better**, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with cumulative GPAs of **3.5/5.0 or better** will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for **5 years after graduation**. Speak with your [**Admissions Manager**](mailto:mbai.admissions@smu.edu.sg) to find out more.
- Please note that meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission. Candidates may still be advised to submit GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test scores to further strengthen their application.
- If you have not taken the GMAT or GRE, you are encouraged to take the SMU Admissions Test. Alternatively, you may first submit your online application and arrange for the GMAT / GRE test to be taken as soon as possible. Do include the date of your test as well.
- FAQ: Applicants should meet at least one of the following: **GMAT ≥ 600, GMAT Focus ≥ 595, GRE ≥ 312, or SMU Admissions Test ≥ 55**.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
English proficiency is expected, with **IELTS 6.5** or **TOEFL 90** as reference benchmarks.
- A valid **TOEFL / IELTS** score is required if the medium of instruction of your undergraduate studies was not English. _Valid for two years from the date of the test._

Program Overview.content:
The SMU Master of Science in Business AI (MBAI) programme develops AI-savvy business leaders who can bridge the gap between technical teams and senior management. Graduates will gain strategic vision, analytical excellence, and the technical literacy needed to lead AI-driven transformation.
The Master of Science in Business AI programme is a **12-month** programme offered on a full-time basis, with a maximum course duration of 1.5 years. It comprises **15 course units** designed to build both AI literacy and strategic business capability. Students engage in **three dedicated AI capacity-building modules** and **six core modules**, both distributed across the programme year. To tailor their learning, students choose **two programme electives** along with **three open electives** that may include courses from other SMU master’s programmes, a **10-week internship**, or an **SMU-X/capstone project**. In addition, students complete **postgraduate professional development workshops** that enhance leadership and career readiness. The programme blends classroom learning with real-world application, ensuring graduates are prepared to lead AI-driven transformation across industries.
Who will benefit from the programme:
- Professionals who want to use AI strategically.
- Managers and aspiring leaders seeking AI literacy to drive business transformation.
- Career switchers aiming to enter the AI-enabled business landscape.
- Practitioners in marketing, finance, HR, operations, or strategy who want to apply AI in their functions.
- Consultants and analysts who need to translate AI insights into clear business recommendations.
- Future-ready leaders looking to manage change, influence stakeholders, and guide responsible AI adoption.
The programme builds strong foundations in business intelligence, responsible AI, and data-driven decision-making with no technical background required. Students learn to apply AI tools and insights across business functions through hands-on modules, real cases, storytelling with data, and a capstone project that bridges classroom learning with real-world execution. Graduates are prepared for roles in consulting, digital transformation, product management, analytics, and more. Students are guided by faculty and industry experts who teach the frontiers of AI-enabled business, equipping them with insight, confidence, and strategic capability to drive change.
Master of Science in Business AI graduates can work in:
- Professional Services and Consulting
- Banking and Financial Services
- Data Analytics
- E-commerce
- Logistics
- Manufacturing
- FMCG
- Government
The programme is a one-year full-time programme that develops business leaders who understand AI technologies and can translate them into strategic, organisational, and operational impact—without training students to become engineers or data scientists. It focuses on business-first, AI-literate leadership. Students learn how to use AI to make decisions, drive transformation, and manage change, not how to build models or code systems.
Graduates will be able to interpret AI-driven insights, lead AI initiatives, manage responsible AI adoption, design data-informed strategies, and influence stakeholders through data storytelling. The programme delivers a balanced mix of managerial and technical content, emphasising strategic understanding of AI applications rather than deep programming or algorithm development. The curriculum structure is highly practical: beyond AI foundational and core modules, students have terms for open electives, an internship, and/or a capstone project designed to solve real-world industry problems. The capstone practicum includes direct engagement with industry experts, and internships provide real-world exposure to AI-enabled business environments.
Typical roles include AI Strategy Manager, Business Intelligence Manager, Product Manager (AI/Data), Digital Transformation Lead, HR Analytics Manager, and Financial/Marketing Intelligence Analyst. SMU's dedicated career services team will actively help students prepare for internships and career opportunities in Singapore and beyond. Career counselling and workshops will be provided to MBAI students, and MBAI students will have access to a career counsellor who will assist with post-graduation placement through guidance and advice. The internship component is also expected to improve employability by providing opportunities for early exposure to the work environment of Singapore. Industries that typically hire Master of Science in Business AI graduates include consulting, finance, technology, e-commerce, public sector, logistics, and analytics-driven industries seeking business professionals fluent in AI.

Curriculum.content:
The Master of Science in Business AI programme is a **12-month programme offered on a full-time basis**, with a maximum course duration of **1.5 years**.
The Master of Science in Business AI is a **12-month**, full-time programme comprising **15 course units** designed to build both AI literacy and strategic business capability. Students engage in **three dedicated AI capacity-building modules** and **six core modules**, both distributed across the programme year. To tailor their learning, students choose **two programme electives** in areas such as creative ideation, business storytelling, and AI-enabled people management, along with **three open electives** that may include courses from other SMU master’s programmes, a **10-week internship**, or an **SMU-X/capstone project**. In addition, students complete **postgraduate professional development workshops** that enhance leadership and career readiness.
Students will take a total of **15 course units (CU)**: **3 AI-Capacity Building + 6 Core + 5 Electives + 1 PGPD**.
**3 AI-Capacity Building Modules**
- Responsible AI Management
- Data-Driven Decision Making with AI
- Human-AI Collaboration
**6 Core Modules**
- Marketing Intelligence and Personalisation Strategy
- Financial Intelligence with AI
- Financial Accounting with AI
- Data Storytelling and AI-Augmented Influencing
- Innovations and Operations in Intelligent Online Marketplaces
- Change Management with Disruptive AI
**5 Elective Modules**: 2 Master of Science in Business AI Electives + 3 Open Electives.
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Programme Electives** | Creative Idea Generation with AI; Business Narratives with AI; HR & People Management with AI Solutions |
| **Open Electives** | Open/shared electives from other SMU Master’s programmes (3 CUs); 10-week Internship (1 CU); SMU-X / Capstone Project (1 CU) |
**Postgraduate Professional Development Workshops**: Students are required to attend **4 full-day workshops** by the end of the programme to fulfil **1 CU**.
The FAQ states that the curriculum includes **3 AI-capacity building courses, 6 core courses, 2 programme electives, 3 open electives, a 10-week internship or capstone option, and professional development workshops**. Students typically attend **four 3-hour seminar classes per week**, leaving the rest of their time flexible for group meetings and self-study. Students can choose electives in creativity, communication, and HR analytics, as well as open electives from other SMU master’s programmes. They may complete a **10-week internship** or an **industry-focused capstone project**.

Financial Aid.content:
Academic Excellence | Global Awareness | SMU-ASEAN | Leadership* | Impact on Asia* | Women in Business* | Community Impact*
*Denotes Scholarships that students can apply for upon admissions into the programme. These scholarships entail award amounts up to 30% of the tuition fee, with no bonds attached.
**The Admissions Scholarship Committee will assess the following:**
- Professional, personal, and academic achievements
- Evidence of making an entrepreneurial impact to business/society
- Interview Performance
- Recommendation from the Academic Director
- **Academic Excellence:** The SMU Master of Science in Business AI will offer the Academic Excellence Award to high-quality candidates with exceptional academic performance. Awards are based on academic merit, final grades and admissions test score.
- **Global Awareness:** The Global Awareness Award is awarded to individuals who will contribute to the classroom diversity and enrich the learning experience of students by way of cultural, personal or professional backgrounds.
- **SMU-ASEAN:** The SMU-ASEAN Scholarships do not require any applications. Applicants who meet the criteria will be considered. The award amounts range from S$5,000 to S$10,000 (inclusive of GST) with no bonds attached. Eligibility criteria: successful admission into the SMU MBAI Programme; open to nationals of ASEAN member countries.
- **Leadership:** Applicants must demonstrate strong leadership capabilities or potential in personal and professional instances. The committee assesses interview performance, a 500-word leadership essay, and leadership quality recognition.
- **Impact on Asia:** The committee assesses interview performance, a 500-word essay on Asian-focused professional development, entrepreneurial or personal projects, and impact such as reach, entrepreneurial projects, awards and helping increased awareness of Asia.
- **Women in Business:** Applicants must have successfully received an admissions offer. The committee assesses interview performance, a 500-word essay, and leadership quality recognition.
- **Community Impact:** The "Community Impact Award" recognises candidates who have contributed to society through outstanding community work and positively impacted members of the community/society. The committee assesses interview performance, an essay, and impact of community work.
- **Lillyn Teh Frontier Endeavour Scholarship:** Application for August 2026 intake closed. Eligibility criteria include: full-time student matriculated in the MBAI programme; Singapore Citizen; must demonstrate academic excellence; must not be a recipient of other Scholarship or sponsorship. Scholarship award is valued at S$90,000 and will offer financial support towards MBAI tuition fees; any excess will be used for study related expenses. No bond is required. A separate application is required after application to the MBAI programme has been completed.
- **Lee Kuan Yew Scholarship:** Eligibility criteria include Singapore citizenship with at least a Second Upper Honours Degree or equivalent Degree, and an excellent track record of leadership and service. In addition to the one-off sum of S$10,000, private sector awardees will receive an annual allowance of S$50,000, while public sector awardees will receive S$10,000 if concurrently sponsored by their organisations. More information and application form/procedures: [here](https://www.psc.gov.sg/home).
- **SkillsFuture:** SkillsFuture Funding is available for Singapore Citizens. [Click on this link for more details.](https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/credit) The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme provides Singapore Citizens aged 40 years and above the SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top up of $4,000 to offset out-of-pocket tuition fees, starting from Academic Year 2024/25 intake, commencing on or after 1 May 2024. Further details: [https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/level-up-programme](https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/level-up-programme).
- **SMU Alumni:** Graduates from SMU undergraduate or postgraduate programmes are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of S$8,000 when applying to the MBAI programme.
- **Singapore Local Autonomous University:** Graduates from NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, or SIT are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of S$4,000 when applying to the MBAI programme.
- Eligible candidates may receive exemptions for up to four credit units, with a discount of $3,000 awarded for each credit unit exempted.
- **SG/PR:** Singaporean citizens and Permanent Residents are eligible for a one-time discount of S$5,000.
- **ASEAN Citizens:** ASEAN citizens are eligible for a one-time discount of S$3,000.
- **Corporate Partner:** Eligible company-sponsored candidates are eligible for a one-time discount of S$6,000. Contact the admissions team to discuss eligibility.
- The above discounts are applicable to students joining the programme from the January 2025 intake onwards. Each student is only eligible for one discount; should a student qualify for more than one discount, only the higher discount will be applicable. The tuition fee discount is deductable before Goods and Services Tax (GST).

Multiple Applications.content: If you have applied for multiple programmes, please contact the programme office of your first choice to register for the administration of the test. Once you have completed the test, do update the other programme office(s) upon the completion of your test via email to ensure timely processing of all your SMU applications.
